name: obsidian-paste-rename
description: Rename pasted images and other attachments in Obsidian.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && BUILD_ENV=production node esbuild.config.mjs && cp manifest.json build
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.release: npm run build && gh release create ${npm_package_version} build/*

author: A Boring Company
